tests: Initial green/yellow dates and user-supplied revision ranges render in Excel.
Changing design Date column C moves the green bar, clears the previous range and updates the linked Gantt.
Changing testing dates moves the yellow bar and clears the previous range.
Editing the original Start/Finish cells on Edit Schedule updates Date column C and both colored Gantt views.
Revision bars can be moved into November and December without leaving old colored cells.
Date ranges accept a regular hyphen or an en dash between the dates.
Clearing Date column C removes the bar in both views.
